title: Lotofácil 3789: Jackpot Hit and R$ 9 Million Estimate
seoTitle: Lotofácil 3789: Jackpot Hit and R$ 9M Estimate
subtitle: Draw 3789 produced a jackpot winner and boosts the prize for the next draw
excerpt: In Lotofácil draw 3789, a single bet matched all 15 numbers to secure R$ 8.05 million. The next draw, scheduled for Sunday, has an estimated R$ 9 million prize.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
In Lotofácil, draw 3789 was held on Friday (25) and produced a winner in the main tier: one bet matched all 15 numbers and will receive R$ 8,055,220.68. The estimated prize for the next draw, which will take place on Sunday (27), reaches R$ 9 million.

Draw 3789 results

The winning numbers were 01, 04, 05, 07, 08, 09, 12, 16, 17, 18, 20, 21, 22, 23, and 24. Among the bets, 15 hits were achieved by 1 ticket, 14 hits by 526 tickets, 13 hits by 18,700 tickets, 12 hits by 165,168 tickets, and 11 hits by 1,023,464 tickets.

Prize distribution

The prizes were distributed as follows: R$ 8,055,220.68 for the 15-point winner, R$ 2,259.58 for each of the 526 tickets with 14 points, R$ 35 for each of the 18,700 tickets with 13 points, R$ 14 for each of the 165,168 tickets with 12 points, and R$ 7 for each of the 1,023,464 tickets with 11 points.

Next draw and prize estimate

The next draw, number 3790, already has R$ 2,399,681.58 rolled over. However, Caixa projects an estimated prize of R$ 9 million for draw 3789, which will be held on Sunday (27). This amount includes the expected revenue from new bets until sales close.

How Lotofácil works

In Lotofácil, players choose between 15 and 20 numbers from the 25 available on the betting slip. The bet price varies according to the amount of numbers marked: R$ 7 for 11 numbers, R$ 14 for 12 numbers, and R$ 35 for 13 numbers. This lottery format also allows 'Surpresinha' (Quick Pick), where Caixa selects the numbers, and 'Teimosinha' (multi-draw), which allows playing the same combination in several consecutive draws.

Notes on prizes

If there is more than one winner in the main tier, the prize is divided among the winning tickets. Caixa Lotteries prizes can be redeemed within 90 calendar days from the draw date. For physical bets, the original ticket must be kept as proof and must be identified with a full name and CPF. In syndicate bets (bolões), each participant receives the share corresponding to their quota, according to the receipt issued for the group bet.

With information from G1, Estadão.
